description_en: Adds or modifies a level-2 data masking scenario
description_zh: 调用DsgSceneAddOrUpdateScene接口，新增或编辑二级脱敏场景
name: DsgSceneAddOrUpdateScene

fields.help_en:
The ID of the level-2 data masking scenario.

If you do not configure this parameter, the current operation is to add a level-2 data masking scenario.
If you configure this parameter, the current operation is to modify a level-2 data masking scenario. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2786322.html operation to query the ID of the level-2 data masking scenario
fields.help_zh:
二级脱敏场景ID。
不配置该参数：表示当前操作为新增二级脱敏场景。
配置该参数：表示编辑指定二级脱敏场景信息。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2786322.html接口查询二级脱敏场景ID
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: If the data masking scenario takes effect for an E-MapReduce (EMR) compute engine, enter the ID of an EMR cluster. This parameter is required only when you use an EMR compute engine
fields.help_zh: 若脱敏场景生效的数据范围为EMR引擎，此处需输入EMR集群ID。仅当使用EMR引擎时需配置该参数
fields.name: cluster_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the compute engine for which the data masking scenario takes effect. Valid values:

ODPS: ODPS.ODPS
HOLO: HOLO.POSTGRES
EMR: EMR
fields.help_zh:
脱敏场景生效的引擎类型。取值如下：
ODPS：ODPS.ODPS
HOLO：HOLO.POSTGRES
EMR：EMR
fields.name: db_type

fields.help_en: The name of the compute engine instance for which the data masking scenario takes effect
fields.help_zh: 脱敏场景生效的引擎实例名称
fields.name: project_name

fields.help_en: The information about the compute engine for which the data masking scenario takes effect
fields.help_zh: 脱敏场景生效的引擎信息
fields.name: projects

fields.help_en:
The code of the level-1 data masking scenario to which the level-2 data masking scenario belongs. Valid values:

dataworks_display_desense_code: masking of displayed data in DataStudio and Data Map
maxcompute_desense_code: data masking at the MaxCompute compute engine layer
maxcompute_new_desense_code: data masking at the MaxCompute compute engine layer (new)
dataworks_analysis_desense_code: masking of displayed data in DataAnalysis
fields.help_zh:
二级脱敏场景所属的一级脱敏场景Code。取值如下：
数据开发/数据地图展示脱敏：dataworks_display_desense_code
MaxCompute引擎层脱敏：maxcompute_desense_code
MaxCompute引擎层脱敏（新）：maxcompute_new_desense_code
数据分析展示脱敏：dataworks_analysis_desense_code
fields.name: scene_code

fields.help_en: The name of the level-2 data masking scenario
fields.name: scene_name

fields.help_en: The information about the user group for which the data masking scenario takes effect
fields.help_zh: 脱敏场景生效的用户组信息
fields.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The information about the level-2 data masking scenario
parameters.name: scenes

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
